info.name: QuickCart - CIA-3 API Testing
info.description: Postman collection for the QuickCart Online Grocery Delivery Platform. Covers the 13 required modules, authentication/RBAC, validation, order workflow, stock, delivery, alerts, slots, reorder and reports. Set environment variables before running.

exec: pm.test('Six delivery slots are available',()=>pm.response.code===200 && pm.response.json().length===6);
pm.test('Public registration cannot create admin',()=>pm.response.code===201 && pm.response.json().role==='customer');
// Run the setup/login requests first and keep the environment variables populated.
